edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/drivers/net/bonding/bond_main.c
+++ /linux/drivers/net/bonding/bond_main.c
@@ -850 +850,2 @@
-			       struct net_device *slave_dev, int reporting)
+			       struct net_device *slave_dev, int reporting,
+			       bool rtnl_held)
@@ -861,0 +863,9 @@
+
+	/* If we are running in RCU context (which calls this),
+	 * we cannot use legacy ops that require RTNL if we don't hold it.
+	 * netdev_need_ops_lock() tells us if we can lock the device (modern)
+	 * or rely on RTNL (legacy).
+	 * If we are legacy and don't hold RTNL, we can't inspect.
+	 */
+	if (!rtnl_held && !netdev_need_ops_lock(slave_dev))
+		return reporting ? -1 : BMSR_LSTATUS;
